newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania to take $20 mln energy credit from UBS.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania to take $20 mln energy credit from UBS.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) is set to lend a total $10 million to the two main state-run energy companies in the Baltic state of Lithuania, a senior finance ministry said on Monday.
Lithuanian Gas and Lithuanian Energy will both borrow $10 million each, the official added.
"The two loans will carry a six-month maturity with the possibility for extension and will be used to buy gas and oil supplies for the winter," the offical said.
She added that the loans could be signed as early as the middle of this week.
Lithuanian Gas owes close to $30 million to Russia's Gazprom and a middleman negotiating company and desperately needs cash to secure supplies for the winter.
Lithuania's state-run energy sector is plagued by financial problems and debt and Western experts say it is in urgent need of reform.
